newsitem.title: UK: British rail schedules go on internet.
newsitem.headline: British rail schedules go on internet.

text.p: Rail travellers in Britain can now look up timetables over the Internet, rail operator Railtrack said on Tuesday.
They can enter a destination, date and time of travel, and find available times, changes and any possible delays.
British Rail has been fragmented into several different companies, and Railtrack's corporate site gathers information about all of them at www.rail.co.uk.
The rail timetable can be accessed at www.rail.co.uk/ukrail/planner/planner.htm.
